A '''rescue mission''' to [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]] was undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to liberate [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] from [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]].

==Prelude==
With the assistance of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], two [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] incarcerated at the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]] were able to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by stowing away onboard the outbound<ref name="Xwing" /> [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Hampton]]''.<ref name="Xwing" />

==The mission==
A rescue team was sent to rendezvous with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and free the prisoners, with the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Mercy (Lambda-class)|''Mercy'']] docking with the ''Hampton'' for their extraction. For the three [[Standard minute|minutes]] that the extraction would take, the Rebel boarders would be vulnerable to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces stopping and searching craft in the area, including the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Furious (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Furious'']], the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] group [[Omicron group (Delta-class)|Omicron]], and the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] of [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]], [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta]], [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma]], and [[Delta Squadron (TIE/LN)|Delta Squadrons]]. In the event of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] arrival, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] were tasked with shielding the shuttle for long enough to complete the rescue.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Aftermath==
The Rebel agents were successfully rescued,<ref name="CSWE" /> and the engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Alliance, intended to teach prospective Y-wing [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] the craft's versatility, escorting Alliance ships while engaging Imperial forces. [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Red Squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the fifth Y-wing historical mission, "Escape From Mytus VII."<ref name="Xwing" />

While the Rebel shuttle present during this mission is identified as the ''Mercy'' by ''X-Wing''{{'s}} [[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]]<ref name="XWOSG" /> and gameplay, the pre-mission briefing refers to it as the ''[[Oola/Legends|Oola]]''.<ref name="Xwing" />
